import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    mod = int(data[2])

    maxn = 510
    c = [[0] * (maxn + 1) for _ in range(maxn + 1)]
    for i in range(maxn + 1):
        c[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            c[i][j] = (c[i-1][j] + c[i-1][j-1]) % mod

    dp_con = [0] * (m + 1)
    sum_con = [0] * (m + 1)
    dp_con[0] = 1
    sum_con[0] = 0
    if m >= 1:
        dp_con[1] = 2
        sum_con[1] = 0

    def Arth(x):
        return x * (x + 1) // 2 % mod

    for i in range(2, m + 1):
        dp_con[i] = 0
        sum_con[i] = 0
        for j in range(i):
            rcon = (dp_con[j] * dp_con[i - j - 1]) % mod * c[i-1][j] % mod
            dp_con[i] = (dp_con[i] + rcon * (i + 1)) % mod
            term1 = (dp_con[j] * sum_con[i - j - 1] + sum_con[j] * dp_con[i - j - 1]) % mod
            term1 = term1 * c[i-1][j] % mod * (i + 1) % mod
            sum_con[i] = (sum_con[i] + term1) % mod
            term2 = rcon * (Arth(j) + Arth(i - 1 - j)) % mod
            sum_con[i] = (sum_con[i] + term2) % mod

    dp = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
    sum_dp = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
    dp[0][0] = 1
    for i in range(m):
        for j in range(i + 1):
            if dp[i][j] == 0:
                continue
            for k in range(1, m - i + 1):
                ni = i + k
                nj = j + 1
                comb = c[i + k][k]
                dp[ni][nj] = (dp[ni][nj] + dp[i][j] * dp_con[k] % mod * comb) % mod
                sum_dp[ni][nj] = (sum_dp[ni][nj] + (dp[i][j] * sum_con[k] + sum_dp[i][j] * dp_con[k]) % mod * comb) % mod

    ans = 0
    for j in range(1, m + 1):
        if n - (m - 1 + j) < 0:
            break
        ans = (ans + sum_dp[m][j] * c[n - (m - 1 + j) + j][j]) % mod

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
